ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( AND(TEXT(PRIORVALUE(StageName)) != $Label.DES_Ready_to_close, TEXT(StageName) = $Label.DES_Ready_to_close), AND(TEXT(PRIORVALUE(StageName)) != $Label.DES_Closed_Won, TEXT(StageName) = $Label.DES_Closed_Won)), ISBLANK(Account.DES_ID_Fiscal__c ), ISBLANK(Account.g_customer_id__c), OR( Account.RecordType.DeveloperName = "Prospect_Subsidiary", Account.RecordType.DeveloperName = "Prospect_Group" ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: It's not possible to advance to Ready to Close/Closed Won an opportunity without completing the "ID Fiscal" or "Client Code" field of a Prospect.
